alt: A cartoon pond habitat has reeds and water lilies, a frog on a rock, and a fish visible below the water.
Three illustrated plant examples show a young leafy tree, a tuft of grass, and moss covering a rock.
A brown cartoon rabbit nibbles a green leaf still attached to a low plant.
A small illustrated pond is surrounded by grass, with reeds and floating water-lily leaves at its edges.
An illustrated forest has tall tree trunks, leafy canopies, ferns, rocks and a fallen log beside a shaded path.
A brown-skinned cartoon child crouches on a garden path and holds a magnifier beside a leaf attached to a plant.
Two green illustrated leaves sit side by side: one narrow with smooth edges and one broad with rounded lobes.
An illustrated garden contains a pink-flowered plant, grass, a snail on soil, and a small bird perched on a leafy branch.
A tan-skinned cartoon child watches an insect on pond reeds from a dry path while an adult stands behind.
Two groups of animal pictures show three similar birds on the left, and one bird, one fish and one rabbit on the right.
Two equally sized illustrated observation frames show grass and a daisy on the left, and a seedling in soil on the right.
Exactly three illustrated snails with spiral shells crawl on the soil bank beside a pond.
A paper sheet shows two leaf sketches, one narrow and one lobed, beside matching leaves and a pencil on a garden table.
A brown-skinned cartoon child on a garden path looks toward a bird with an open beak perched in a tree.
A cartoon garden has flowering plants, grass, a tree and a dense shrub, with no animals visible.
Two illustrated pond scenes show reeds and water lilies; a frog is visible in one and a duck in the other.
Dense illustrated reeds and overlapping leaves conceal the space behind them at a pond edge; no animal is visible.
Two illustrated habitats show a fish among pond plants and a lizard beside a rock on dry sunny ground.
An illustrated leafy plant has roots shown below the soil, raindrops on its leaves, and sunlight above.
A small brown illustrated bird perches beside a nest in a leafy tree near a pond and seed-bearing grasses.
Two illustrated scenes show four similar ladybird beetles on the left, and one beetle, snail, butterfly and earthworm on the right.
A brown-skinned cartoon child using a wheelchair points at a habitat picture while a light-skinned child with glasses draws a leaf.
Two cartoon children with notebooks examine framed garden areas, one grassy and one beneath a shrub.
An illustrated owl perches in a garden tree and a moth flies above shrubs beneath a darkening evening sky.
Two illustrated picture lists show reeds, a fish and a snail on one sheet, and a tree, bird and snail on the other, with a pencil below.
